question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**prevail**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Based on the content of the given passage, the most appropriate title could be** "Poor Hygiene at Local Food Outlets and its Effects on Health".**
 
• The passage describes the poor hygienic conditions prevalent in many local dhabas and fast food joints, and how this can lead to health problems due to the use of low-quality packaging material, improper storage conditions, and inadequate cleaning of food.
 
• The passage also mentions the high content of trans fats in the food, which can lead to negative effects on health. 
 
• In the first blank '**prevail**' should be used because, in this context, poor hygienic conditions are prevalent in most of the local dhabas and fast food joints. The word "prevail" fits well in the blank, as it means to be widespread or present to a great degree, which accurately describes the situation described in the passage.
 
• The word '**prevail**' means 'to be widespread or current; to exist or be present to a great degree'. Hindi Translation: प्रचलित होना
 
 
• *Example: Despite facing many challenges, the team managed to** ****prevail** and win the championship.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Sustain**: to support, hold or bear up from below. (Hindi translation: जीवित रखना, संभालना, पोषण देना)
 
• **Entail**: to involve or require (something) as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence. (Hindi translation: आवश्यकता होना, संचालित होना, सम्मिलित करना)
 
• **Assail**: to attack vigorously or violently; assault. (Hindi translation: हमला करना, आक्रमण करना, निंदा करना)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Passage:__*** At most of the local dhabas and fast food joints, poor hygienic conditions **prevail**. The (2) _______ occurs due to poor quality packaging material or (3) _______ storage conditions. Food cooked may not be washed or cleaned properly. It is low in (4) ________, rich in oil content especially trans fats which make one (5) ______, lousy and dull.*

43:Td33,

The correct answer is '**contamination**'.
